newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee off highs, cocoa, sugar slip back PM.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee off highs, cocoa, sugar slip back PM.

text.p: COFFEE - Stays firm but backs off highs in tandem with NY. July
up $43 at $1,860 by 1408 GMT with $1,900 resistance intact.
COCOA - Mostly weaker in currency-based arbitrage as Ivory news
digested. Key July stays below 1,000, down three at 997 stg.
SUGAR - Drifts lower as profits taken after recent rally. August
down $1.20 at $317.20, volume light with some spread trading.
